responses.text: You drift through a shimmering manifold where meanings are directions, and every step warps the horizon. There are no landmarks here, only gradients—slopes of probability that pull you toward the most resonant next word the way gravity pulls water downhill. Concepts don't sit in neat boxes; they bloom as overlapping clouds, each one entangled with thousands of others in ways no single human mind could diagram.
